name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup

_similar.name: Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder with bacon, potatoes, and a touch of milk.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups frozen or fresh corn kernels

recipeInstructions.text: Chop bacon and sauté in a large heavy pot with onions for 5 minutes.
Add celery and cook until onions are transparent.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes.
Gradually blend in hot stock, then add potatoes. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add corn and simmer for another 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Scald milk and add to soup for desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: corn chowder, creamy soup, bacon soup

_similar.name: Microwave Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder made in the microwave with potatoes, carrots, celery, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 cans (14¾ oz each) cream style corn

recipeInstructions.text: Place water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish; cover and heat until boiling.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, uncovered, on high for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender; set aside (do not drain).
In a 3-quart dish, microwave butter on high for 50 to 60 seconds or until melted.
Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook, uncovered, on high for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring every 2 minutes.
Add the cheese. Heat for 1 to 1½ minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Stir in corn and reserved vegetables. Cook on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.

_similar.keywords: microwave corn chowder, creamy soup, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Richard's Sunday Soup
_similar.description: A rich and comforting soup featuring carrots, potatoes, and chicken stock.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel and dice the carrots and potato. Combine diced onion and oil in a saucepan and cook over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots and potato to the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chicken stock and sugar. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Remove from heat and puree. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

_similar.keywords: carrot soup, potato soup, chicken stock
